summary.text: Bill Whitmire is a Republican member of the South Carolina House of Representatives from District 1 and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election.
A retired educator who owns S&W Farms, he has served in the House since 2002.

paragraphs.text: Bill Whitmire earned an A.B. from Piedmont College in 1972 and served in the United States Army Reserve from 1971 to 1977.
He worked as an educator for Oconee County and is now retired, and he is the owner of S&W Farms.
He served as mayor pro tempore of Walhalla from 1998 to 1999 and as mayor of Walhalla from 2000 to 2002.
Whitmire assumed office in the South Carolina House of Representatives in 2002, and his current term ends on November 9, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists him on the Ways and Means Committee for 2025-2026 and as chair of the Education and Public Works Committee in the 2011-2014 sessions.
He defeated Craig Diem in the June 9, 2026, Republican primary and faces Democrat Jasmine Williams in the general election.
